description:
Free, forever, no account. Hand back an attestation -- yours or one someone else gave you -- and find out whether the signature holds and whether we issued it. Works on attestations this service did not produce: the answer for those is a clear no, which is the point. Holds no database, so it keeps working whoever is running it.

When to use: Someone handed you an attestation, or you want to check one of yours.
Parameters: attestation: the full attest_page response or just its attestation object, as JSON text.
Returns: whether the signature is valid and whether this service issued it, with the reasons.

attestation.description: The attestation as JSON text: either the whole response from attest_page or just its `attestation` object.

name: verify_attestation
title: Check an attestation is genuine
